avis.texte: Put this mask on and had a glass of wine and watched Landman. My face feet so soft and moisturized when I was done. Looked so fresh and relaxed. I highly recommend this routine at least once a week. :)
I rate this a five because it really works, it leaves my face soft and moisturized. Definitely buying it

avis.titre: Nice mask for a relaxing skincare routine
avis.texte: I have tried a lot of sheet masks, and this one stands out because the sheet fits well and does not feel overly thick or messy. The essence absorbs nicely into my skin, leaving it feeling hydrated, soft, and refreshed after removing the mask. It has a light, pleasant scent and feels like a simple way to add a little extra care to my nighttime routine. I like using this when my skin feels dry or tired because it gives my face a smoother and more refreshed look the next morning. It is easy to use, comfortable to wear, and does not leave a sticky feeling afterward. A good option if you enjoy Korean skincare and want an affordable at-home spa treatment.
